Sandbox_BusStop_UseItemPayment_tooltip: When enabled, fares are deducted from the player's inventory (Currency Item). If both Pay with Items and Pay with Bank are active, items are deducted first.
Sandbox_BusStop_UseBankPayment_tooltip: When enabled, fares are deducted from a bank mod's balance via its API (requires Bank Mod Global). If both sources are active, the bank covers any amount that items could not cover.
Sandbox_BusStop_BankModGlobal_tooltip: Name of the Lua global the bank mod exposes its API under (e.g. MyBankMod). Must have a .API table with canAfford, deduct, formatLabel. Only used when Pay with Bank is enabled.
Sandbox_BusStop_CurrencyItem_tooltip: Item type used as bus fare currency (e.g. Base.Money). Only used when Pay with Items is enabled.
Sandbox_BusStop_BasePrice_tooltip: Base cost in currency items for any trip, regardless of distance.
Sandbox_BusStop_PricePerTile_tooltip: Extra cost per tile of distance for dynamic pricing. Value is multiplied by 0.001 — default 1 means 0.001 per tile.
Sandbox_BusStop_EnableRandomTrip_tooltip: When enabled, a Random Trip button appears in the travel panel. The destination is chosen randomly by the server from all available stops.
Sandbox_BusStop_RandomTripPrice_tooltip: Flat fare charged when a player uses the Random Trip button. Set to 0 for free random trips.
